gates.name: Specification handoff
gates.purpose: Prove that the V1 specification is complete, internally consistent, source-faithful, and implementable.
gates.completionRule: All G1 cases pass; decision-level TBDs and contradictions are zero; implementation-only deferrals are bounded and owned.

gates.name: Implementation conformance
gates.purpose: Prove contracts, deterministic behavior, report composition, compatibility, privacy, and safety on implemented backends.
gates.completionRule: All non-waivable G2 cases pass on their assigned backends and every permitted waiver satisfies the matrix policy.

gates.name: Rollout readiness
gates.purpose: Prove live source health, operational thresholds, coexistence, promotion evidence, and rollback safety.
gates.completionRule: The KZO-243 phase evidence and every G3 acceptance manifest are complete and approved by the release and operations owners.

baselineCutoffPolicy: Capture primary real-subject evidence at one completed Taiwan trading-day cutoff after all mandatory daily datasets are due, then bind one knowledgeAt after applicable grace windows. Historical, filing-deadline, transfer, and lifecycle cases declare separate immutable cutoffs.

fixturePolicy.mutationRule: Derive adverse fixtures from an authentic captured base with an explicit mutation recipe. Pure synthetic evidence is reserved for otherwise impossible contract states and is labelled synthetic.
fixturePolicy.privateDataRule: Portfolio fixtures are fully synthetic and contain no production-derived user identifiers or private facts.
fixturePolicy.redistributionRule: Retain a legally permitted artifact or excerpt. When redistribution is prohibited, retain the artifact in controlled storage and publish its hash and reproducible retrieval instructions.

referenceSubjects.validationPolicy: Run the primary full case; smoke-check fallback identity, eligibility, routing, and required source availability at every rollout phase.
Run the primary full case; smoke-check fallback identity, eligibility, routing, and required source availability at every rollout phase.

uniqueCoverage: valid withholding when cycle support is inadequate
referenceSubjects.validationPolicy: Use a pinned historical evidence bundle spanning an identifiable cycle; never rely on the current point in the cycle alone.

uniqueCoverage: no improvised P/B, dividend-discount, excess-return, or liquidation method
referenceSubjects.validationPolicy: A withheld fair value is the expected successful result unless every common-method gate genuinely passes.
Use a real cross-check path. DCF-primary override remains a deterministic fixture unless a revalidated real snapshot satisfies the override.
Preserve not-expected pre-listing ranges and never fabricate or automatically stitch predecessor history.
